verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own marketing says it plugs in Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, and AWS, and its pricing page lists importing Grafana and Datadog dashboards, so the core integration claim exists. However, the support comes only from a marketing-page list, with no documented setup guides in the pack. CloudWatch is only implied by a generic 'AWS' mention, and Sentry is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: documented setup guides for each integration, explicit CloudWatch integration, Sentry integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup

citations.quote: Plug in the services you already use including Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Azure, AWS & Google Cloud.
